issues.description: The compute-table global is named '_CT' in the template dd.py but is imported and used as 'CT' in dd_simulation.py. The reference name 'CT' is also used in the solution. This mismatch means students running the provided template will encounter a missing identifier/import error or confusion about which compute-table to use. Because the compute table is a core shared utility used throughout the simulator (lookup/insert calls), the naming mismatch prevents a clear one-to-one mapping between the template and the intended implementation in the solution.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the compute-table global name consistent across artifacts. E.g., in template_repository/dd.py rename '_CT = ComputeTable()' to 'CT = ComputeTable()' (matching dd_simulation.py and the solution). Alternatively, change imports/usages in dd_simulation.py to use '_CT', but the recommended fix is to expose it as 'CT' to match the reference implementation and avoid confusion.
